negative_prompt: lettering, captions, signatures, watermarks, decorative borders, skeleton, skeletal body, bare skull, exposed teeth without lips, bare ribcage, centered portrait, close-up face, living person, standing person, multiple bodies, upright healthy anatomy, floating body, disconnected spike, organic trees, leafy branches, isolated obelisks, symmetrical rows, bright cheerful colors, glossy plastic, smooth 3D render, uniform sharpness, decorative fantasy armor

references.role: architectural shapes, density and monumental scale

review_criteria.description: One small but legible flesh-covered adult corpse in the nearer middle distance, a connected side-spur visibly emerging through its wounded chest, intact facial flesh, mottled skin and heavily dangling limbs; reject a skeleton or bare skull. The monumental thorn field remains the main subject.
Dense, angular, tapered manufactured thorns match the architectural reference; avoid isolated obelisks and organic trees.

Painterly grimdark fine art with bold asymmetrical silhouettes, selective impasto and lost edges, a charcoal/olive/ash palette and layered atmospheric depth; avoid glossy rendering and uniform detail.

Assess low-viewpoint composition, interlocking shape design, narrow raking light, selective brushwork and visual hierarchy: architecture on first glance, shocking human remains on second reading. Detail or resolution alone is not artistic quality.

Oppressive scale and encroaching storm create dread; the legible impalement wound, flesh-covered dead face and broken hanging posture deliver a disturbing human consequence. A tiny unreadable body, skeleton or merely dark palette does not satisfy this criterion.
Convincing supported geometry, gravity and anatomy without unrelated objects, duplicated forms or unwanted lettering.
